name: arXiv API
tagline: Search and retrieve physics, math, and CS preprints
description: Search and retrieve metadata for arXiv preprints (physics, math, CS, and other fields) via an Atom 1.0 API; no authentication required.

auth.details: No authentication or API key is required for the public Atom query API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No formal free-tier quota; free use subject to fair-use rate limits (≤1 request every 3 seconds, single connection). No paid plans.

rate_limits: ≤1 request every 3 seconds; single concurrent connection per source. Avoid bursts; use OAI-PMH/bulk for large harvests. max_results capped at 30000 (slices ≤2000).

example.response_snippet:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:opensearch="http://a9.com/-/spec/opensearch/1.1/" xmlns:arxiv="http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom">
  <title>ArXiv Query: search_query=all:electron&id_list=&start=0&max_results=1</title>
  <opensearch:totalResults>1000</opensearch:totalResults>
  <entry>
    <id>http://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ex/0307015</id>
    <title>Multi-Electron Production at High Transverse Momenta in ep Collisions at HERA</title>
    <summary>Multi-electron production is studied at high electron transverse momentum...</summary>
  </entry>
</feed>
